name: com.streethawk.library.feeds.SHCoreModuleReceiver
description: This component is part of the StreetHawk mobile engagement SDK. When StreetHawk's app-status response reports a changed feed timestamp, this receiver notifies the feed listener and announces that a new feed item is available in the app.
disableEffect: New StreetHawk feed items may not be announced or refreshed in the app's feed.
